verdict.rationale: Muse's docs describe goal/task tracking that runs on a schedule and reacts to events, following up and notifying the user when needed (muse-docs-20, muse-docs-24, muse-docs-35, muse-docs-5), which matches the recurring/one-off automated task story. However, independent hands-on testing found the agent's control plane starts timing out under stress, exposing failure points in the automation architecture (muse-comm-1), and there is no detailed documentation of scheduling granularity, retry behavior, or explicit 'result delivery' guarantees beyond notifications. Missing for 10: technical specifics on recurrence/scheduling configuration, evidence of reliable completion under real-world load, and independent corroboration beyond one stress-test report.
